identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Govern configuration-generation handoff across CSM, Guardian, and kernel

values.goal: Give Runtime configuration one immutable generation receipt and atomic active reference shared by CSM, Guardian, kernel, status, and readiness.
values.required_outcome: Every Runtime launch and reload participant validates and reports one committed configuration generation and digest, with deterministic crash recovery and prior-generation restoration.
declared_scope: Runtime configuration-generation receipt and atomic active reference
CSM Guardian kernel status and readiness generation propagation
isolated failpoint and prior-generation recovery tests
authority_boundary: No live Runtime rollout restart or mutation
No binary installer or stable-route redesign
No convergence-policy or provider behavior changes
operator_constraints: Reuse merged #589 transaction primitives and #678 generation routing
